title: Solid, Liquid or Gas
short: An element's state at room temperature.
trouble: Confusing the symbol's language (Latin names) with the English name.

blocks.html: The periodic table is a map you can read. This drill works on an element's state at room temperature.
Tip: Only bromine and mercury are liquid at room temperature; a handful are gases; everything else is solid.
Questions are generated from the published element data — the same numbers the Periodic table dataset shows.
